gloss: Mr., Ms., Mrs.; (after occupations, shops, animals) polite or friendly suffix

definitions.explanation: A polite title suffix attached to names, similar to 'Mr.' or 'Ms.' in English. It is also attached to occupations, shops and companies, and, in talk with or among children, to animals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧さん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{診|み}る→診る：09798_miru⟧。
examples.notes: さん can be added to occupation words like 患者 for politeness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いらっしゃいます→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
お⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧さん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: Often combined with お〜 prefix for added politeness.

examples.japanese: ⟦パン{屋|や}→パン屋：19415_panya⟧さん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|しょく}パン→食パン：14636_shokupan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a loaf of bread at the bakery.
examples.notes: With a shop, 〜屋さん names the shop or the person who runs it; it sounds friendlier than plain パン屋.

notes:
〜さん is the most common honorific suffix in Japanese.

USAGE:
- Attached to family names: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さん
- Attached to given names: {太郎|たろう}さん
- Attached to occupations: ⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧さん (driver)
- Attached to roles: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧さん (patient), お⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧さん (customer)
- Attached to shops, meaning the shop or the person who runs it: ⟦{八百屋|やおや}→八百屋：02978_yaoya⟧さん (greengrocer), ⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧さん (bookshop), ⟦パン{屋|や}→パン屋：19415_panya⟧さん (bakery)
- Attached to another company's name in business talk: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧{商事|しょうじ}さん
- Children's speech, and adults talking to children, for animals and things: ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧さん, お⟦{猿|さる}→猿：02213_saru⟧さん, お⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧さん.

OTHER HONORIFIC SUFFIXES:
- 〜⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧: more formal/respectful
- 〜くん: for males (often younger/subordinate)
- 〜ちゃん: affectionate, for children/close friends
- 〜⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: for teachers, doctors, etc.

WATCH OUT:
Never attach 〜さん to your own name. Speaking to someone outside your company or family, drop it from members of your own group too: a receptionist says ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}して→外す：02394_hazusu⟧おります, not ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さん.
